info.title: fennecdb: fennec-shard
info.description: fennec-shard's REST API: each tenant's routes below /t/{tenant}, forwarded to its node, and the router's own at the root. Its /_shard/ routes are its admin's, in the sharding reference. A request takes `Authorization: Bearer` with the server's token (--http-token) or a scoped JSON Web Token (--jwt-secret, --jwt-keys), held to the --policy rules; a server started with neither takes requests with no token. Every answer carries X-Request-Id; a refusal is {"error": "..."} under a status that says what to do about it, and a 503 says when to come back in Retry-After and its body's retry_after. A route marked x-fennec-flag is served under those flags. A GET answering HEAD lists a head operation beside it, and every path answers a CORS preflight under --http-cors.

token.description: The server's token (--http-token): every collection, unscoped.

jwt.description: A scoped token: a JSON Web Token signed under --jwt-secret or --jwt-keys (HS256, RS256, ES256), held to the --policy rules at every level, on a node bound to the tenant it names.

replication.description: --replication-token: what a replica, an archiver or a router sends.

tenant.name: tenant
tenant.description: A tenant's name: its file on its node.

hook.name: hook
hook.description: A webhook consumer: a line of the hooks file, or a tenant's hook.

Filter.name: filter
Filter.description: field=operator.value, each an AND: eq neq lt lte gt gte like has in is, not. before one; a value alone is an equality (?year=2024).

Where.name: where
Where.description: A FennecQL filter, for what the pattern cannot say: year >= 2024 and tags has "rust".

Select.name: select
Select.description: The fields, or aggregates: title,year or status,count(*),sum(total).

Order.name: order
Order.description: year.desc,title.asc; a collation among the modifiers: name.und.desc.

Count.name: count
Count.description: Present: the number of matching rows, not the rows.

Facet.name: facet
Facet.description: Each value's count beside the rows: brand top 5,color.

Lookup.name: lookup
Lookup.description: Another collection's matching documents attached to each row.

Returning.name: returning
Returning.description: The rows a write made, not their count: id,title (* every field).

Consumer.name: consumer
Consumer.description: Start from where this consumer committed.

Wait.name: wait
Wait.description: Milliseconds to wait for a write when there is none yet.

As.name: as
As.description: fennecql: the schema as its statements.

Mode.name: mode
Mode.description: follow: only what the description declares and the server lacks.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a write once: a retry with the same key and request is answered as the first try was; the key with another request is 422.

FennecWait.name: Fennec-Wait
FennecWait.description: Milliseconds to hold a set or a del that writes nothing, or a call whose body does, until it writes (30000 at most).

FennecAfter.name: Fennec-After
FennecAfter.description: Answer from nothing older than this change (a Fennec-Seq an answer named): a replica waits for it, 504 past the wait.

FennecHistory.name: Fennec-History
FennecHistory.description: The history Fennec-After's change is of, as an answer named it.

FennecRead.name: Fennec-Read
FennecRead.description: replica: a read a router may answer from a read replica; every server runs it read-only.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: A read's last ETag: 304 while nothing it reads was written.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The row's ETag (a list of them), or *: answered or written only where the row is one tagged (* any row there), compared strongly, under the write lock that writes it; else 412 and nothing written.

IfNoneMatchRow.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatchRow.description: A read: the row's last ETag, 304 while it is that row. A write: *, made only where there is no such row (a PUT's create), or tags it must not be; else 412 and nothing written.

WebhookId.name: webhook-id
WebhookId.description: A Standard Webhooks event's id (or svix-id).

WebhookTimestamp.name: webhook-timestamp
WebhookTimestamp.description: A Standard Webhooks event's time (or svix-timestamp).

WebhookSignature.name: webhook-signature
WebhookSignature.description: A Standard Webhooks event's signature (or svix-signature).

GitHubDelivery.name: X-GitHub-Delivery
GitHubDelivery.description: A GitHub event's key, where its hook says key delivery.

RequestId.description: The request's id, in every log line and span it made; one sent is kept.

FennecSeq.description: The change the answer was read at, or the write landed as.

FennecNext.description: The since of the next page.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before coming back.

ETag.description: The row's tag: a hash of the row as the token is shown it, the same on every server for the same row. On a write, where it was sent with a precondition: the row's tag as the write left it.

NoTransform.description: no-transform, beside a row's ETag: a proxy compressing the answer would weaken the tag, which If-Match compares strongly.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait, as Retry-After says.

retry_after_ms.description: A quota's wait, to the millisecond.

at.description: The statement of a batch that stopped.

outcome.description: A write whose outcome the server cannot know.

Document.description: A document: its fields, id among them. Open on purpose: any field is taken, the collection's schema (GET /_schema) holding each it declares to its type.

Fields.description: The fields to set on each row it reaches, each to its value, the rest left as they are. Open on purpose: any of the collection's fields, the schema (GET /_schema) saying which.

Event.description: The sender's event as it signed it, read only once its signature verifies. Open on purpose: any JSON object its sender sends; a Stripe event names its id, which keys it.

Instance.description: A file's identity on its node, 16 hex digits.

Instances.description: The identities a file may carry: a list, or one.

Lineage.description: The lineage a tenant's history is of, 8 hex digits.

Promote.description: What the router knows of the tenant, which the copy is held to (409 where it differs); left out, nothing is said.

history.description: The history its primary forked at its last failover.

Follow.description: Whom the tenant follows; left out, this node's upstream.

from.description: The node to follow, its address.

reader.description: A read replica's copy, which no hook's answer waits for.

ms.description: How long it runs, from when the node answered the grant acked names.

epoch.description: The list's: a node holding another answers 412, to be sent primaries.

primaries.description: The tenants the node is primary of.

acked.description: The grant it acknowledges, sent beside grant.

Hook.description: A hook's scheme and secrets, refused (400) as a hooks file's line is.

secrets.description: Its secret as its sender shows it, or two while one rolls.

keep.description: How long an event's key is kept: 30d.

tolerance.description: How far an event's time may be from the server's, 1s to 1h: 5m.

key.description: A github hook's: its events keyed by their body or by X-GitHub-Delivery.

max_body.description: The most bytes an event takes: 64k.

HookSecrets.description: A tenant's hook secrets whole, as GET .../hook-secrets answers them: a set holding a hook names its version.

set.description: When it was set, in ms since the epoch; left out, now.

tenant.description: The answer's own, taken and not read.

Answer.description: A statement's answer: its rows, a count, or what a write did.

query.description: A FennecQL statement, or SQL's spelling of one.

vector.description: What to rank by: a vector field's numbers, a point's [longitude, latitude], or a sparse field's text form {index:value,...}/dimension, as pgvector's sparsevec writes it.

field.description: The vector, sparse or point field, where the collection has several.

ef.description: The graph search's beam: how many candidates it keeps.

exact.description: true: every row compared, no index.

where.description: A FennecQL filter, ANDed with the query string's.

select.description: The fields to answer: a list, or one field's name.

match.description: Words BM25 ranks too over a @text field: a hybrid search, the two rankings fused by reciprocal rank.

match_field.description: The @text field match ranks, where the collection has several.

match_fuzzy.description: true, or the most edits a word of match may take.

match_prefix.description: The last word of match a prefix.

candidates.description: How many candidates each side ranks.

Description.description: A schema description, as Schema in code sends it.

Refused.description: A refusal: its status says what to do about it.

Unverified.description: The event did not verify: its headers, scheme, time, size, hook or signature, one answer for each.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or a wrong one.

Unavailable.description: Come back after Retry-After seconds. Fennec-Unserved (as the connection was taken) or, from fennec-shard, Fennec-Unsent: 1 says the request never ran.

NotModified.description: Unchanged since the If-None-Match tag: no body, the read not run.

RowNotModified.description: The row is the one the If-None-Match tag names: no body.

RowMade.description: The row was made: there was none of that id. Its ETag where the PUT was sent with a precondition.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match or If-None-Match did not hold for the row as the write lock found it: nothing written.
